briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensified in early August 2026 with multiple frontier model releases and record funding. US-China tensions over advanced chips remain elevated while safety concerns grow around agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; Google deployed Gemini 3; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI and DeepSeek both shipped major updates. Competition now centers on multi-agent orchestration.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators in US and EU pushed new disclosure rules while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp; Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 100k H100-equivalent clusters; TSMC reported continued AI chip delays into 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed effort by end of 2027?
